frontier.hypothesis: combine's MERGE path is a third insn_count channel in which freeness does NOT imply inertness: a 2- or 3-insn pre-combine group that folds into a single pattern the target already emits is counted by count_loop_regs_set before loop_optimize and costs nothing after it, while both halves compute real values.
frontier.mechanism: combine_instructions runs at toplev.c:3004, after loop_optimize at toplev.c:2895, so anything it merges was already counted. Unlike force_to_mode (which erases computation that cannot reach the stored bits) and strength_reduce's biv elimination (which erases computation nothing consumes), a merge preserves the value - so the added insn can be semantically real and the T1/T2 objection that killed both deletion channels does not automatically apply. The [[split-init-accumulation-sanctioned]] owner feedback already treats same-variable split-init and compound-assignment splits as ORDINARY C, which is the admissibility handle the deletion channels never had.
frontier.next_probe: Re-spell the four existing division/modulo statements in decomposed-but-identical forms and read insn_count against emitted asm lines with tmp/grind/func_8003C714/s14/sweep.sh (one cc1 run per form, no sandbox needed): `x >> 10` as two ashiftrt steps; `% 60` as `x - (x / 60) * 60`; `(x % 30) * 100` decomposed into the shift/add chain GCC itself emits; `/ 1800` as a split-init sequence on a single named variable. Any form whose .loop insn_count rises while emitted asm stays at 107 is a live carrier; measure how many such splits the body admits and compare against the +63 requirement (or +57 if combined with K24's free order dial, which is worth another -6 on threshold).

frontier.hypothesis: The named-intermediate family supplies free insn_count in this loop, at +1 per intermediate, and is the only sanctioned family measured to do so.
frontier.mechanism: `v = *src;` ahead of `dst[0x24] = v;` measured 56 -> 57 insn_count at 107 -> 107 emitted asm lines: the copy is coalesced after loop_optimize but exists when count_loop_regs_set runs. The named-intermediate family (.claude/rules/narrow-byte-args-packed-call.md plus the 2026-08-17 clarification in no-new-park-categories.md) has six prongs including once-written/once-read and byte-neutrality, both of which this instance satisfies.
frontier.next_probe: Sweep how many ordinary named intermediates the body admits without changing emitted bytes - one per loaded value, one per division result, one per stored byte - and read the cumulative .loop insn_count. If the ceiling is small (expected: 4-8) it will not close the +63 gap alone, but it is the free baseline that any merge-path carrier stacks on top of, and it lowers the merge-path requirement by exactly that amount.

frontier.hypothesis: The layer-1 declaration puns flagged in candidate.c are a submission blocker independent of the floor, and will need to be settled before ANY distance-0 body can be filed.
frontier.mechanism: The brief's auto-scan flags `src = (u8 *)&D_80106A58 + i * 8;` (D_80106A58 is a per-word splat sub-symbol of g_file_disc_type @80106A54, declared `extern u8 g_file_disc_type;`) and `*((u8 *)s0 + 0x30) = *(u16 *)&D_80101ED2;`. The sanctioned fix is the aggregate-merge family at the DECLARATION in include/*.h via an integration handoff, prongs (a)-(e), and prong (c)'s 2026-09-03 amendment requires the sub-symbol rows to be kept with an `alias of <base>+N; retire with func_80035280` suffix because func_80035280 is still INCLUDE_ASM.
frontier.next_probe: Before any candidate-ready on this function, check whether prong (a) can be satisfied for D_80106A58 - the target's loop uses a single base register `$a2` with a stride-8 increment (`addiu $a2, $a2, 0x8` at 8003C830), which is base-register/stride evidence rather than the forbidden adjacency-of-splat-names evidence. Draft the header-canonical merged declaration and route it as an integration handoff; do not spell it as a per-use cast.
